_note: Two emulated ESP32-C6 motes on one 802.15.4 medium, both running Contiki-NG (github.com/joakimeriksson/contiki-ng-esp32, -DCONTIKI_NULLNET=ON) as unmodified IDF apps. The medium and the lock-step are in the module (esp32c6::net): a transmission cuts a node's slice at the TX_START write and the frame goes on the air at its first preamble byte. The second mote powers on 1.3 s later — two identical images booted together stay deterministic to the cycle, so their timers never drift apart and every broadcast collides.
